Batch: JoeWare ChangePw, ClientTest and CPAU publisher source review

Scope.AdFindAcceptance: Excluded from selected acceptance batches as previously directed; no AdFind source or payload action in this batch.

Findings: Publisher describes ChangePw as a command-line password set/change utility; current page version 2.03.0, dated 2006-06-26.
Publisher lists historical support through Windows XP and administrator/account-operator permissions for setting passwords; changing requires the old password and applicable directory permission.
Source code is not available according to the publisher page.
Publisher describes ClientTest as a GUI TCP/IP socket communication tester; current page version 1.01.0, dated 2005-11-09.
Publisher lists historical support through Windows XP, no special security requirement, and no source code availability.
Publisher describes CPAU as an alternate-security-context process launcher with optional job files containing encoded credentials and command lines; current page version 1.11.0, dated 2005-11-08.
Publisher explicitly says job-file encoding is obfuscation, not strong encryption; it also says CPAU will not run as LocalSystem.
The publisher page lists historical support for Windows 2000, Server 2003 and XP, and no source code availability.
